coverage.signoff_scope: normal-state DC short, source-fight, and rail-coupling topology plus registered DC fault-topology cases only
limitations: no transient, startup, fault-energy, thermal, or signal-integrity simulation
no firmware, digital protocol, analog-accuracy, or protection-threshold proof
single-source rail coupling is diagnostic information, not an automatic failure
